title: Completion flag after two steps
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet, let $G$ take three optional cell values to an optional cell value, and let $st$ be a scan state. Apply the scan-state step determined by $G$ twice, each time with the pair consisting of two present copies of the distinguished cell value, and take the Boolean entry of the resulting scan state. This Boolean is the completion flag after the two steps.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet
